# Command reference

Every Docker command this course runs, grouped by what it works on. For each one: what it does, the flags
the course uses, and where it is used. The **first** link is the lesson that teaches it; the others show it
in use. Numbers are lessons (`012`), `T07` a troubleshooting problem, `P03` a project, `A10` a module
assessment.

Every command accepts `--help`: `docker run --help`, `docker compose up --help`.

Contents: [Containers](#containers) · [Inspecting and debugging](#inspecting-and-debugging) · [Images](#images) · [Builds](#builds) · [Networks](#networks) · [Volumes](#volumes) · [Docker Compose](#docker-compose) · [Registries](#registries) · [Security](#security) · [Engine and system](#engine-and-system)
